component.name: alibaba-ots
component.title: Alibaba Tablestore (OTS)
component.description: Perform row operations on Alibaba Cloud Tablestore (OTS).
component.label: cloud,database

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

CamelAlibabaOtsOperation.label: producer
CamelAlibabaOtsOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. This header replaces the operation option.

CamelAlibabaOtsRequestId.label: producer
CamelAlibabaOtsRequestId.description: The request ID that Tablestore returns in the response to the operation. The producer sets it when the operation succeeds.

producerIn.description: The request of the Tablestore SDK for the row operations, such as a PutRowRequest for putRow: any other body fails. listTables does not read the body

producerOut.description: A Map of the response for the row operations: the requestId, the consumedCapacity and the row as a Map of its primaryKey and columns. listTables gives a List of the table names

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAlibabaOtsOperation header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of the Tablestore instance, which starts with http:// or https://, for example https://my-instance.cn-hangzhou.ots.aliyuncs.com. Not used when the otsClient option is set or autowired.

instanceName.description: The name of the Tablestore instance. Not used when the otsClient option is set or autowired.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

otsClient.label: advanced
otsClient.description: To use a custom com.alicloud.openservices.tablestore.SyncClient. The producer sends its requests with this client, and the endpoint, instanceName, accessKey, secretKey and serviceKeys options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not shut down a client that is set or autowired. If no client is set or autowired, the Camel endpoint creates a SyncClient from these options when the producer processes its first message, and shuts it down when the Camel endpoint stops.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The AccessKey ID of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to Tablestore. If not set, the accessKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the otsClient option is set or autowired.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The AccessKey secret of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to Tablestore. If not set, the secretKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the otsClient option is set or autowired.

serviceKeys.label: security
serviceKeys.description: The AccessKey pair as an org.apache.camel.component.alibaba.common.models.ServiceKeys, whose accessKey is the AccessKey ID and whose secretKey is the AccessKey secret. Each of the two is used when the option of the same name is not set. Not used when the otsClient option is set or autowired.
